entities.name: Baird, Steward of Argive
entities.description: Steward of Argive who speaks of the city's ancient walls as a lesson in peace.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: A realm whose walls were built by a peaceful dynastic union and have guarded it against war for fifteen centuries.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A land whose people, the Benalish, are said to be born upon the peak of the mountain of Honor.

entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: A paragon of the Capashen line who vows to protect the less fortunate and fight on against despair.

entities.name: Capashen
entities.description: A noble family whose members hold to a code of protection and courage.

entities.name: Null Moon
entities.description: A moon whose light took form as Evra, according to the Fall of the Thran.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: An ancient civilization whose mysteries have been inherited, though few of the answers.

entities.name: Kwende, Pride of Femeref
entities.description: A descendant of a vanished land and student of a forgotten general, a master of unforgeable blades.

entities.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: An angel who tells others they are not alone.

entities.name: The Ancestor
entities.description: A revered figure believed to have saved its followers for a purpose.

entities.name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
entities.description: An apostle of the Ancestor.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker whose spark was held in a crystal from Jhoira; he keeps watch for the lost and longs for a home he cannot return to.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Captain who restored the Weatherlight and took its wheel for the first time in a millennium.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the story is set, to which the marids came from a distant home.

entities.name: Marids
entities.description: The oldest tribe of djinn, first to arrive on Dominaria and most respected by storm and sea.

entities.name: Tetsuko Umezawa
entities.description: A fugitive descendant of Toshiro who claims mastery of making great bad choices.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Tetsuko's ancestor, who said life is a series of choices between bad and worse.

entities.name: Zahid, Djinn of the Lamp
entities.description: A djinn who does as he pleases and is amused by mortals' wishes.

entities.name: Mazeura
entities.description: A person whose life, name and work are declared lost and forgotten in Chainer's Torment.

entities.name: House of Vess
entities.description: A fallen noble house whose estate's forest became the Caligo Morass.

entities.name: Caligo Morass
entities.description: A vast bog stalked by nameless horrors, formerly the forest surrounding the Vess estate.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: A young member of the House of Vess whose body was never found.

entities.name: Urgoros, the Empty One
entities.description: A phantom whose passage makes the city of Vhelnish scream in silence.

entities.name: Vhelnish
entities.description: A city haunted by the phantom Urgoros.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The Demonlord whose seat of power is the Cabal Stronghold; he transformed his lieutenant Yar-Kul into a maggot.

entities.name: Whisper, Blood Liturgist
entities.description: A Cabal liturgist who praises how the Demonlord has trained victims to beg for the knife.

entities.name: Yar-Kul
entities.description: Belzenlok's overly ambitious lieutenant, transformed into a maggot.

entities.name: Squee, the Immortal
entities.description: A long-lived goblin who cannot die.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest that is one aware being, though not always awake.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who seeks to atone for his failures toward Dominaria and speaks of Yavimaya's awareness.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: An ancient frozen era of which the Territorial Allosaurus is a living remnant.

entities.name: Ghitu
entities.description: A people known for passionate intensity.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A ship restored by Jhoira after a millennium.

entities.name: Arvad the Cursed
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member with an 'illness' who believes his destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: The land to which Grand Warlord Radha offers the future as a gift.

entities.name: Grand Warlord Radha
entities.description: A warlord devoted to Keld's future.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: An archmage described across chronicles of many ages.

entities.name: Arkol
entities.description: An Argivian scholar who speculates that Jodah is a family or arcane title.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A being who calls Muldrotha his child.

entities.name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
entities.description: Multani's child, who grew from rot and ruin.

entities.name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
entities.description: A druid who considers herself one part of the single being Yavimaya.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A planeswalker in whose hands the Blackblade may taste an elder dragon's blood.

entities.name: Blackblade Reforged
entities.description: A blade that spilled the blood of one elder dragon.

entities.name: Vesuva
entities.description: A realm whose queen had the Helm of the Host forged from flowstone.

entities.name: Helm of the Host
entities.description: A helm forged out of flowstone for the queen of Vesuva.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Belzenlok's dark organization, whose influence spreads from Urborg.

entities.name: Cabal Stronghold
entities.description: The seat of Belzenlok's power and gathering place of the Cabal.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The region from which the Cabal's influence spreads.

entities.name: Epityr
entities.description: Site of a sunlit temple remembering angelic saviors.

entities.name: Riverspan
entities.description: A town built on the hull of a downed Phyrexian portal ship.

entities.name: Alene of Riverspan
entities.description: A resident of Riverspan proud of her town's history.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders whose portal ship was brought down by Riverspan's ancestors.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A holy figure whose blessing lies strongest upon Sursi.

entities.name: Sursi
entities.description: A place where Serra's holy chapels remain untouched by the Cabal.

events.summary: In the past, the forest around the Vess estate became the Caligo Morass with the fall of the House of Vess.
events.quote: The forest surrounding the Vess estate became the Caligo Morass, a vast bog stalked by horrors too terrible to name.

events.summary: Belzenlok transforms his overambitious lieutenant Yar-Kul into a maggot; a spirit later bursts from the frog that ate it.
events.quote: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot.

events.summary: Riverspan's ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship and built their town on its hull (past).
events.quote: Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull.

events.summary: Jhoira gives Teferi a crystal pulsing with his planeswalker spark.
events.quote: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's planeswalker spark.

events.summary: Jhoira restores the Weatherlight and takes its wheel for the first time in a millennium.
events.quote: As she took the wheel of the *Weatherlight* for the first time in a millennium, Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship.
